item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-R04-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-R04-E002","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"Human Rights Watch states that martial law in North Kivu and Ituri facilitated abuses by government security forces; armed groups and often abusive security forces carried out massacres, abductions, rape and sexual violence, child recruitment, and other attacks on civilians with near-total impunity.","notes":["The excerpt does not clearly attribute every listed abuse specifically to government security forces."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-R04-E003","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0012-R04-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
